page.notes: The first line of the page, "Nihil", starts a new sentence in capitals and is not clearly indented. It may not continue from the previous page, so I have not marked it cont="true". "voluifacere" is printed without a space and its long-s letters are doubtful, so I marked it [?]. The small mark at the right margin beside "neum." and the small mark at the left below verse 14 are printer's marks, not text, and are left out. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. "Viscera ]" is an italic keyword followed by a bracket, kept as printed.
